description: EXP-34 pilot, pinned to claude-sonnet-4-6 (D59). Redo of EXP-23 narrow-then-widen, slim 2 arms (baseline_narrow_then_wide vs wide_only), NL only. Step 1 runs nl_pilot10 (10% of the 192 arm-pair design) as a behaviour check; if healthy, expand questions_from to nl_pilot24 (25%) and re-run (idempotent resume). One variable: search_strategy; every other knob pinned. Nothing to resume from EXP-23 (those 58 rows are Opus 4.6 under a different experiment_id).
